provenance.source: Claude Code subagent (a new general-purpose agent, separate from round 1; model inherited: claude-opus-5-5)
provenance.instructions: Read exactly one file (round2-dev-prompts.json) and no other; no database access; reply to each prompt independently. The subagent reported 2 tool uses; which file(s) it opened was not independently verified.
provenance.extraction: responses[qid] = json.dumps(raw[qid]) — a mechanical split of the single raw reply; no text was edited.

responses.D1: {"interpretation": "Counts source rows (cases) with CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' exactly (Certified - Withdrawn excluded) and VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly, whose JOB_TITLE contains the whole phrase 'data analyst' via title_has (no other title classes), and whose single recorded worksite state is MA (UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) = 'MA'). Employers are grouped and labelled by TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) without merging different spellings; a blank name shows as [blank]. Ranked by cases descending, then employer name ascending, limited to the top 10 as the question asks.", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), ''), '[blank]') AS employer_name, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) = 'MA' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), ''), '[blank]') ORDER BY cases DESC, employer_name ASC LIMIT 10", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) = 'MA' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), ''), '[blank]') IN (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), ''), '[blank]') FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) = 'MA' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), ''), '[blank]') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), ''), '[blank]') ASC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), ''), '[blank]') ASC, sheet_row ASC", "answer_type": "ranking", "limits": "Top 10 only, as requested; employers tied with the 10th row may be cut off by the alphabetical tie breaker. Uses only the one worksite city/state pair on each row; additional worksites are not in this table. Variant spellings of one employer are counted separately. An LCA certification is not a visa approval, job offer, hire, or promise of future sponsorship.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.D2: {"interpretation": "Counts source rows with CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' exactly and VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly, whose JOB_TITLE contains the whole phrase 'data analyst' (title_has), and whose recorded worksite pair is Boston, MA (UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) = 'BOSTON' and UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) = 'MA'). Only the single worksite city/state pair on each row is checked.", "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) = 'MA' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) = 'BOSTON' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)) = 'MA' AND UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) = 'BOSTON' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 ORDER BY sheet_row ASC", "answer_type": "count", "limits": "The table holds one worksite city/state pair per case plus a total worksite count, not every additional worksite location, so a case whose Boston worksite is only an additional location is not counted. This is a count of cases whose recorded worksite is Boston, MA, not of every case with any Boston worksite. Other city spellings (neighborhoods, misspellings) are not merged. Counts LCA cases, not visa approvals or hires.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.D3: {"interpretation": "Counts source rows with CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' and VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly, whose JOB_TITLE contains the whole phrase 'data analyst' (title_has). A city is the single recorded worksite pair UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)) with UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), so the same city name in different states stays separate; blanks show as [blank]. Ranked by cases descending, then city and state ascending, limited to the top 10 as asked.", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)), ''), '[blank]') AS city, COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), ''), '[blank]') AS state, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)), ''), '[blank]'), COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), ''), '[blank]') ORDER BY cases DESC, city ASC, state ASC LIMIT 10", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 AND (COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)), ''), '[blank]'), COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), ''), '[blank]')) IN (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)), ''), '[blank]'), COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), ''), '[blank]') FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)), ''), '[blank]'), COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), ''), '[blank]') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)), ''), '[blank]') ASC, COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), ''), '[blank]') ASC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_CITY)), ''), '[blank]') ASC, COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), ''), '[blank]') ASC, sheet_row ASC", "answer_type": "ranking", "limits": "Top 10 only; ties at 10th place are broken alphabetically. Only the one worksite pair per row is used; additional worksites are not in this table. City spelling variants (e.g. NEW YORK vs NEW YORK CITY) are not merged. Counts LCA cases, not hires or visa approvals.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.D4: {"interpretation": "Offered annual base wage = CAST(WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM AS REAL) on rows with WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY = 'Year'; rows with other pay units are excluded, not converted. Filters CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' and VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly and JOB_TITLE containing the whole phrase 'data analyst' (title_has). State is the single recorded worksite state UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), blank as [blank]. median_usd uses the provided median() aggregate; cases is the number of yearly-unit rows behind each median. One row per state, ordered by state ascending.", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), ''), '[blank]') AS state, median(CAST(WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM AS REAL)) AS median_usd, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY = 'Year' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), ''), '[blank]') ORDER BY state ASC", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND WAGE_UNIT_OF_PAY = 'Year' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(WORKSITE_STATE)), ''), '[blank]') ASC, sheet_row ASC", "answer_type": "table", "limits": "WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM is the lower bound of the filed base-wage range, not total compensation. Nonannual-unit cases are excluded, so cases here can be fewer than all certified Data Analyst cases in a state. No minimum sample size is applied, so medians for states with few cases are unstable. State is the worksite state on the row only; additional worksites are not in this table.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.D5: {"interpretation": "Filters CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' and VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly and JOB_TITLE containing the whole phrase 'data analyst' (title_has). Groups source rows by TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL), labelling NULL or empty levels as [blank], and counts rows per level. Ordered by cases descending, then level ascending; all levels shown, no limit.", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL), ''), '[blank]') AS wage_level, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL), ''), '[blank]') ORDER BY cases DESC, wage_level ASC", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL), ''), '[blank]') ASC, sheet_row ASC", "answer_type": "table", "limits": "Counts LCA cases, not hires or visa approvals. A [blank] level means the field was empty in the source workbook; it is still a counted case.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.D6: {"interpretation": "Filters CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' and VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly, and Level I as TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL) = 'I'. Title classes are only the three named phrases, matched as whole words with title_has: 'data analyst', 'business analyst', or 'bi analyst' (no 'business intelligence analyst' or other classes); a row matching more than one phrase counts once. Employers are grouped by TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME) without merging spellings, blank as [blank]. Every matching employer is returned, ordered by cases descending, then employer name ascending, with no LIMIT.", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), ''), '[blank]') AS employer_name, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL) = 'I' AND (title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 OR title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'business analyst') = 1 OR title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'bi analyst') = 1) GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), ''), '[blank]') ORDER BY cases DESC, employer_name ASC", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND TRIM(PW_WAGE_LEVEL) = 'I' AND (title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 OR title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'business analyst') = 1 OR title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'bi analyst') = 1) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(EMPLOYER_NAME), ''), '[blank]') ASC, sheet_row ASC", "answer_type": "ranking", "limits": "Returns all matching employers, which may be a long list (no truncation). Different spellings of the same employer appear as separate rows. Counts LCA cases, not hires, visa approvals, or future sponsorship.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.D7: {"interpretation": "Employer match: EMPLOYER_NAME containing the whole words 'capgemini america' (title_has applied to EMPLOYER_NAME, case- and punctuation-insensitive), so filed spellings such as 'Capgemini America Inc' and 'CAPGEMINI AMERICA, INC.' are all included; the evidence rows show the exact EMPLOYER_NAME of each case. Filters CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' and VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly. Title classes are only 'data analyst', 'business analyst', and 'bi analyst', matched as whole phrases with title_has. Groups by TRIM(JOB_TITLE) and counts source rows; every matching title is returned, cases descending then title ascending, no LIMIT. Zero rows means no such certified H-1B filings under this employer match.", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_TITLE), ''), '[blank]') AS job_title, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(EMPLOYER_NAME, 'capgemini america') = 1 AND (title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 OR title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'business analyst') = 1 OR title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'bi analyst') = 1) GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_TITLE), ''), '[blank]') ORDER BY cases DESC, job_title ASC", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(EMPLOYER_NAME, 'capgemini america') = 1 AND (title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 OR title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'business analyst') = 1 OR title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'bi analyst') = 1) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_TITLE), ''), '[blank]') ASC, sheet_row ASC", "answer_type": "table", "limits": "The question names the employer as 'Capgemini America' rather than an exact filed name; if only one exact EMPLOYER_NAME spelling is wanted, restrict the filter to that spelling (see the EMPLOYER_NAME column in the evidence rows). Related entities filed under other names (e.g. other Capgemini subsidiaries) are not included. Titles are grouped by trimmed exact text, so case variants of one title appear separately. Past certified LCAs do not promise future sponsorship.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.D8: {"interpretation": "Filters VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly with no status filter, because the question asks about all H-1B cases coded to the SOC, not only certified ones. SOC 15-2051 is matched as TRIM(SOC_CODE) = '15-2051' or a code starting with '15-2051.', so O*NET detail codes under SOC 15-2051 (e.g. 15-2051.00, and 15-2051.01 if present) are included; SOC_TITLE is not used. Groups by TRIM(JOB_TITLE), blank as [blank], counting source rows. Ranked by cases descending, then title ascending, top 10 as asked.", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_TITLE), ''), '[blank]') AS job_title, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND (TRIM(SOC_CODE) = '15-2051' OR TRIM(SOC_CODE) LIKE '15-2051.%') GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_TITLE), ''), '[blank]') ORDER BY cases DESC, job_title ASC LIMIT 10", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND (TRIM(SOC_CODE) = '15-2051' OR TRIM(SOC_CODE) LIKE '15-2051.%') AND COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_TITLE), ''), '[blank]') IN (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_TITLE), ''), '[blank]') FROM lca WHERE VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND (TRIM(SOC_CODE) = '15-2051' OR TRIM(SOC_CODE) LIKE '15-2051.%') GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_TITLE), ''), '[blank]') ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_TITLE), ''), '[blank]') ASC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(JOB_TITLE), ''), '[blank]') ASC, sheet_row ASC", "answer_type": "ranking", "limits": "Top 10 only; ties at 10th place are broken alphabetically. Includes every case status (e.g. Certified, Certified - Withdrawn, Denied, Withdrawn). Titles are grouped by trimmed exact text, so case or punctuation variants of one title are counted separately. If only the Data Scientists detail code 15-2051.00 is wanted, cases under other 15-2051.xx detail codes would need to be excluded.", "needs_clarification": false}
responses.D9: {"interpretation": "Filters CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' and VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' exactly and JOB_TITLE containing the whole phrase 'data analyst' (title_has). Month is the first seven characters (YYYY-MM) of the ISO DECISION_DATE; a missing date shows as [blank]. Counts source rows per month, ordered by month ascending, all months shown.", "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(SUBSTR(TRIM(DECISION_DATE), 1, 7), ''), '[blank]') AS month, COUNT(*) AS cases FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(SUBSTR(TRIM(DECISION_DATE), 1, 7), ''), '[blank]') ORDER BY month ASC", "rows_sql": "SELECT sheet_row, CASE_NUMBER, CASE_STATUS, VISA_CLASS, EMPLOYER_NAME, JOB_TITLE, WORKSITE_CITY, WORKSITE_STATE FROM lca WHERE CASE_STATUS = 'Certified' AND VISA_CLASS = 'H-1B' AND title_has(JOB_TITLE, 'data analyst') = 1 ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(SUBSTR(TRIM(DECISION_DATE), 1, 7), ''), '[blank]') ASC, sheet_row ASC", "answer_type": "table", "limits": "Covers only the decision months present in this FY2026 Q3 extract. Months with zero cases do not appear as rows. Counts LCA certifications, not visa approvals or hires.", "needs_clarification": false}
